title: 第四章    校花—苏林依
content_zh:
陈木拿着制作好的药丸，便查阅了一番宁华市哪边可以出售珍奇古玩的地方，果然让陈木找到了这个地方，在宁华化市确实有一个地方，各种稀奇古怪的东西都有的卖，虽然这里面大多数是假货，但有些人运气好，也是可以淘到一些珍贵的文物，这地方就是“聚宝苑”。

    到了聚宝苑，陈木先是将这里所有的东西都看了一遍，微微摇了摇头，他发现这些东西没有一个是有灵气的宝物，全部都是一些没有用的东西。

    陈木根据这里的物价，分析了一番，便开始他第一次卖药丸，不过在卖之前陈木用真气将自己的脸覆盖住，这样做的目的也是不想让其他人，在事后打扰他的修炼生活。

    毕竟陈木是知道他的药丸的功效，特别是那两粒护心丸，已经无限接近于1阶丹药，在聚宝苑找了一个比较偏僻的角落，陈木将他炼制的十粒药丸拿了出来，分好类后，铺在了地上开始了出售。

    存放药丸的小瓶子上都贴着一张小纸条，写着每种药丸的名字。

    陈木之所以要到这个杂货市场来卖这药丸，也是因为这里宁华市的政府唯一一块不管的地方，具体原因陈木不知道，但这样却刚好方便了陈木出手他的药丸。

    陈木这十粒药丸没有准备全部卖光，但却抱着要么不开张，开张吃一年的想法，所以他的每一粒药丸都卖的很贵。不过陈木也知道，他的药丸在需要它的人手上或许是无价之宝，但在平常人眼里，可能一文不值。

    “嗨，来看看，这里竟然有人在卖大力丸！哈哈，真有意思。”陈木摆了一会探子，边走来了数人，有男有女，一名男子颇感兴趣的对着陈木的药丸瓶子说道，“你这药丸都怎么卖的？”

    在这男子看来，这些药丸无非都是一些骗人的玩意，应该不会太贵。

    陈木见到自己这小摊子刚摆好，就立刻有人来问价格了，心里霎是高兴，站起身子对着男子说道：“这些药丸，除了护心丸每个两万块钱，其他的药丸每粒一万。”
content_en:
Chen Mu took the prepared pills and looked up where to buy rare antiques in Ninghua City. Sure enough, Chen Mu found this place. There is indeed a place in Ninghua City where all kinds of strange and weird things are sold. Although most of them are fakes, some people are lucky and can also find some precious cultural relics. This place is "Jubaoyuan".

When he arrived at Jubaoyuan, Chen Mu first looked at everything here and shook his head slightly. He found that none of these things were spiritual treasures, and they were all useless things.

Chen Mu analyzed the prices here and started selling pills for the first time. However, before selling, Chen Mu covered his face with his true energy. The purpose of this was not to let others disturb his cultivation life afterwards.

After all, Chen Mu knew the efficacy of his pills, especially the two heart-protecting pills, which were extremely close to the first-level elixirs. Finding a relatively remote corner in Jubaoyuan, Chen Mu took out the ten pills he had refined, sorted them, spread them on the ground and started selling them.

The small bottles in which the pills are stored have a small piece of paper with the name of each pill written on them.

The reason why Chen Mu came to this grocery market to sell the pills was because it was the only place where the Ninghua City government had no control. Chen Mu didn't know the specific reason, but it just made it easier for Chen Mu to sell his pills.

Chen Mu did not intend to sell out all ten pills, but he had the idea of ​​​​either not opening the store or opening it for a year, so every pill he sold was very expensive.However, Chen Mu also knows that his pills may be priceless in the hands of those who need them, but they may be worthless in the eyes of ordinary people.

"Hey, come and see, someone is selling Dali Pills here! Haha, it's really interesting." Chen Mu posed as a spy for a while, and several people, both men and women, walked over. One man looked at Chen Mu's pill bottle with interest and said, "How do you sell these pills?"

In this man's opinion, these pills are nothing more than deceptive stuff and shouldn't be too expensive.

Chen Mu saw that as soon as his stall was set up, someone came to ask about the price. He felt happy for a moment. He stood up and said to the man: "Except for the Heart-protecting Pills, which cost 20,000 yuan each, the other pills cost 10,000 yuan each."
